    # QWERTY substitution alphabet
    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"

def fn(x):
    # QWERTY substitution alphabet
    plain = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cipher = "qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm"
    # build mapping dictionaries for lower and upper case
    lower_map = {p: c for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}
    upper_map = {p.upper(): c.upper() for p, c in zip(plain, cipher)}
    trans = {**lower_map, **upper_map}

    # translate each character, leaving non‑letters unchanged
    return "".join(trans.get(ch, ch) for ch in x)
